verdict.rationale: Netlify's first-party docs describe a public REST API for programmatically managing sites, deploys, DNS and more, which is the core of driving the product via a documented API. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths tried; that does not contradict the API's existence, but it weakens the machine-readable, agent-friendly side of the story. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, evidence of endpoint coverage and authentication details, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API—ideal for automating workflows and integrating into your systems.
